name: What types of home additions can you build?

mainEntity.name: What types of home additions can you build?

acceptedAnswer.text: Blue Lake Construction handles a wide range of residential additions across the Salt Lake Valley. Common projects include primary suite additions, kitchen expansions, extra bedrooms, family room extensions, in-law suites, and attached garages. Homeowners also hire general contractors for bump-out additions to add square footage to an existing room, sunroom extensions, or full second-story additions. Each type requires dedicated structural planning, foundation work, and interior remodeling to connect the new footprint seamlessly to the rest of your existing floor plan.
acceptedAnswer.description: We build room additions, primary suites, kitchen expansions, in-law suites, bump-outs, second-story additions, sunrooms, and attached garages tailored to your home's layout.
